_comment: Hand-curated. Every entry says WHY it has the role it has. Roles: mobile | fixed-broadband | carrier-core | unknown. Confidence: observed (we saw real mobile traffic exit from this ASN) | registry-name (the RIR/whois record names it as mobile or broadband) | uncertain (we could not confirm the role). The generator only adds announced prefixes; it never changes a role.

evidence: RIPEstat as-overview holder: SINGTELMOBILE-AS-AP - SINGTEL MOBILE INTERNET SERVICE PROVIDER Singapore
Observed 2026-08-26: two Singtel SIM modems egressed as 119.234.8.104 and 119.234.34.225, both originated by AS45143 (RIPEstat network-info)
RIPEstat as-overview holder: SINGTEL-AS-AP - Singapore Telecommunications Ltd
Singtel's main network ASN. Our Singtel mobile SIMs did NOT egress from it (they egress from AS45143)
RIPEstat as-overview holder: SINGNET - SingNet (Singtel's consumer internet service)
RIPEstat as-overview holder: SINGTEL-FIBRE - Singtel Fibre Broadband
RIPEstat as-overview holder: MOBILEONELTD-AS-AP - MobileOne Ltd. Mobile/Internet Service Provider Singapore
Observed 2026-09-02: three M1 SIM modems egressed as 119.56.16.102, 119.56.16.96 and 119.56.17.42, all originated by AS4773 (RIPEstat network-info)
RIPEstat as-overview holder: M1NET-SG-AP - M1 NET LTD
Often quoted as 'the M1 ASN', but our M1 mobile SIMs did NOT egress from it (they egress from AS4773)
RIPEstat as-overview holder: MOBILEONELTD-AS-NGNBN - M1 Limited/ Next Generation Broadband Network (NGNBN = Singapore's national fibre network)
RIPEstat as-overview holder: STARHUB-MOBILE2 - StarHub Ltd
APNIC whois descr: 'StarHub Mobile2'
Not confirmed with a live StarHub SIM by us
RIPEstat as-overview holder: STARHUB-MOBILE - StarHub Ltd
RIPEstat reports it as NOT announced (no prefixes) as of 2026-09-23; kept so old references to it resolve
RIPEstat as-overview holder: STARHUB-INTERNET - StarHub Ltd
RIPEstat as-overview holder: STARHUB-NGNBN - Starhub Ltd (NGNBN = Singapore's national fibre network)
RIPEstat as-overview holder: STPL-SG-AP - Simba Telecom Pte Ltd; APNIC whois descr: Simba Telecom Pte Ltd
Simba runs a Singapore mobile network, but the registry record does not say this ASN carries mobile subscribers and we have not observed Simba SIM egress
